title: Chapter 4: The Road Through the Forest
chineseTitle: 第 4 章：穿过森林的旅程

paragraphs.en: After a few hours the road began to be rough, and the walking grew so difficult that the Scarecrow often stumbled over the yellow bricks, which were here very uneven. Sometimes, indeed, they were broken or missing altogether, leaving holes that Toto jumped over and Dorothy walked around. As for the Scarecrow, having no brains, he walked straight ahead, and so stepped into the holes and fell at full length upon the hard bricks.
paragraphs.zh: 几个小时后道路开始变得粗糙，步行变得如此困难，以至于稻草人经常在黄砖上绊倒（这里的黄砖极其不平）。有时确实砖块破损或完全缺失，留下了托托跳过、多萝茜绕过的坑洞。至于稻草人，因为没有脑子，他直直往前走，因此踏进坑洞整个人摔倒在硬砖上。

paragraphs.en: It never hurt him, however, and Dorothy would pick him up and set him upon his feet again, while he joined her in laughing merrily at his own mishap. The trees grew thicker and closer together, and the road entered a dark, dense forest.
paragraphs.zh: 然而这从未伤到他，多萝茜会把他拉起来让他重新站立，而他加入她为他自己的不幸愉快地大笑。树木长得越来越密越来越近，道路步入了一片黑暗、密集的森林。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow marvelled at the green leaves, the fragrant blossoms, and the strange calls of forest birds. 'I have so much to learn,' he remarked thoughtfully, 'for my head was only painted yesterday! But if Oz gives me a brain, I shall know as much as any man in the world.'
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人惊叹于绿叶、香气扑鼻的花朵以及森林鸟儿神奇的叫声。“我有那么多东西要学习，”他深思地注意到，“因为我的头昨天才刚画好！但如果奥兹给我一个脑子，我就会和世界上任何男人一样懂得多。”

paragraphs.en: The Yellow Brick Road wound onward through the magical countryside of Oz, flanked by sparkling brooks, colorful wild flowers, and strange golden trees. Dorothy tightly held Toto in her arms, her magical Silver Shoes sparkling with every step she took toward their goal.
paragraphs.zh: 黄砖路沿着奥兹国奇幻的乡村继续盘旋，两侧环绕着闪烁的小溪、绚丽的野花与神奇的金树。多萝茜把托托紧抱在怀里，她魔法银鞋在她朝目标迈出的每一步中都闪闪发光。

paragraphs.en: 'No matter how dreary our home in Kansas may be,' Dorothy remarked softly to the Scarecrow, 'we people of flesh and blood would rather live there than in any other country, be it ever so beautiful. There is no place like home.'
paragraphs.zh: '无论我们在堪萨斯的家多么沉闷，'多萝茜对稻草人软软地注意到，'我们血肉之躯的人们宁愿住在那里，也不愿住在任何其他国家（无论它多么美丽）。没有任何地方像家一样。'
